intro.text: General of the Idrian armies and an old friend of King Dedelin: a burly man with a thick beard.

items.text: As he and Dedelin weigh the danger of war, Yarda persuades the king that honouring the treaty, and sending a princess to marry the God King, will hold Hallandren off for longer.
His son is Parlin, whom Dedelin often wished could marry Vivenna; the treaty had already promised her to Hallandren.

He and Dedelin could find no lasting answer to Hallandren, where more voices each year called for an attack on the so-called rebel Idrians. Yarda judged Idris's northern passes too tempting a prize for Hallandren to leave alone.

personality.text: Dedelin calls him a hard man forged by hard winters, yet as good a man as he has known. Yarda would send a single soldier to his death without a second thought if it put the rest of the army in a stronger position. His meetings with the king tend to run for hours.
